name: sales
description: Experimental sales method and additive qualification/handoff requirements; no outreach authority is implied.

planning.duty: Plan the selected sales result using the supplied buyer context, offer and relationship. Define the appropriate qualification or next-step evidence, keeping a proposed action distinct from permission to contact anyone.

planning.text: Where a response or handoff is part of the task, identify the intended recipient context, qualifying information and next step. Do not invent buyer intent or an agreement.

implementation.text: Carry out only the selected scope: drafting is not sending, an attempted contact is not a conversation, and a conversation is not a closed agreement.

verification.text: Check the actual response, handoff or agreement required by the selected task. A local draft may be verified as a draft without claiming that outreach occurred or a prospect converted.
